requirement.original: File attachment/upload button missing from input toolbar. useAttachments.ts hook and AttachmentStrip.tsx component exist in codebase but are never imported or referenced in AgentInput.tsx or SessionView.tsx. Server upload endpoint POST /v3/sessions/:id/upload exists. The UI wiring was lost during merge with origin.
requirement.clarified: Re-wire the existing useAttachments hook and AttachmentStrip component into AgentInput.tsx and SessionView.tsx, restoring the paperclip button, attachment strip display, and attachment-aware message sending that was removed during the upstream merge.
requirement.what: Restore file attachment UI wiring in AgentInput.tsx and SessionView.tsx
requirement.why: The upstream merge (commit 925f5960) rewrote both files and dropped all attachment integration, leaving fully-implemented but orphaned attachment code

included: Add useAttachments hook call in SessionView.tsx
Add attachment props to AgentInput interface and pass them from SessionView
Add paperclip button to AgentInput action button row
Render AttachmentStrip above input field in AgentInput
Pass readyAttachments to sync.sendMessage() on send
Allow sending when text is empty but attachments exist

success_criteria: Paperclip button visible in AgentInput toolbar
Tapping paperclip allows picking image or document
Selected files appear in AttachmentStrip above input
Send button enabled when attachments present (even without text)
sync.sendMessage called with attachment metadata on send
No TypeScript type errors (yarn typecheck passes)
constraints: Must not modify useAttachments.ts or AttachmentStrip.tsx
Must follow existing AgentInput button pattern (Pressable with Ionicons/Octicons)
Must work across all agent types (claude, codex, gemini, openclaw)
Must use t() for any new user-visible strings

root_cause_analysis.symptom: No file attachment button in AgentInput toolbar; useAttachments and AttachmentStrip exist but are orphaned
root_cause_analysis.root_cause: Merge commit 925f5960 ('Merge upstream slopus/happy -- 153 commits') rewrote AgentInput.tsx and SessionView.tsx, dropping all attachment imports, props, AttachmentStrip rendering, and useAttachments hook usage
root_cause_analysis.root_cause_commit: 925f5960 - Merge upstream slopus/happy (153 commits): Expo SDK 55, new session composer, voice refactor, OpenClaw, profile removal, SIGPIPE fix
root_cause_analysis.why_introduced: Large upstream merge (153 commits) included a full rewrite of the session input UI with new features (OpenClaw, voice refactor, new session composer). The merge resolution favored the upstream version of AgentInput/SessionView which did not have the attachment wiring (it was a local-only feature added in f8b208fa).
root_cause_analysis.why_problematic: The attachment feature (commit f8b208fa) was a complete end-to-end implementation: server endpoint, CLI download, app hook, UI components, and wiring. The merge preserved the backend and standalone components but silently dropped the UI integration layer, leaving dead code.
root_cause_analysis.timeline: f8b208fa (2026-03-23): attachment feature added -> 925f5960 (merge): UI wiring removed -> current: orphaned components

context.codebase_state: useAttachments.ts and AttachmentStrip.tsx are complete and functional. sync.sendMessage() accepts an optional attachments parameter. Server POST /v3/sessions/:id/upload exists. Only the UI wiring in AgentInput and SessionView is missing.
context.recent_commits: 925f5960 (merge) removed wiring, f8b208fa (original) added full feature, f6f129a1 (auto-commit) minor update to attachment files

file_contents.useAttachments.ts: Fully implemented hook: pickImage, pickDocument, addFileFromPaste, clearAttachments, removeAttachment, readyAttachments, hasAttachments. Persists to MMKV with debouncing.
file_contents.AttachmentStrip.tsx: Horizontal scrollable strip with AttachmentChip sub-component. Shows image thumbnails or file icons, upload spinner, error overlay, remove button.
file_contents.AgentInput.tsx: 1200-line component with action button row (gear, agent, abort, git status) and send button. No attachment references currently.
file_contents.SessionView.tsx: Session view with AgentInput composer. Calls sync.sendMessage(sessionId, message) without attachments parameter.

development_approach.strategy: Re-add the props and wiring that were removed in commit 925f5960, adapting to the current AgentInput layout (which has changed significantly since the original implementation). The original commit's diff serves as a reference for what was removed.
development_approach.validation_approach: 1) yarn typecheck passes, 2) Playwright visual verification: paperclip button visible, image picker opens, attachment strip renders, 3) Functional test: attach image + send message -> verify sync.sendMessage called with attachments

research_findings.reason: Straightforward re-wiring of existing, proven code that was accidentally removed during merge. The original implementation (commit f8b208fa) provides a complete reference.
